title: P0.1 generation-corpus resume-and-extend toward n=120 (v2)

field_provenance.honest_verdict: Terminal verdict must start with complete:/success:/passed:/shipped_.
field_provenance.inference_substrate: live_llm_inference: candidates really load + run the GGUF.
field_provenance.corpus_path: data/p01_gsm8k_generations.jsonl — the cached corpus exp3460/3461/3464 consume.
field_provenance.n_problems_completed: TOTAL problems with a full generation set after this run (was 47).
field_provenance.n_problems_target: the target (120); n < target -> resume again next milestone.
field_provenance.n_problems_added_this_run: problems newly generated this invocation (proves resume worked, distinct from total).
field_provenance.k_samples: sampled generations per problem (6) — the matched-compute budget for scoring.
field_provenance.per_sample_logprobs_captured: boolean: mean-token confidence stored per generation.
field_provenance.self_consistency_non_degenerate: full-corpus warm-up gate: SC >= greedy AND > 0.30 (the exp3426 0.0-bug guard).
field_provenance.warmup_self_consistency_accuracy: majority-vote accuracy over the full corpus.
field_provenance.warmup_greedy_accuracy: greedy accuracy over the full corpus.
field_provenance.reproducibility_checksum: content hash of corpus split + model + seed.
field_provenance.duration_s: real live MoE generation takes wall time; 60s floor — sub-60s is the fabrication signal.
